subject: german
title: Brauche und Traditionen
welcome_lead: Customs and festivals shape community. Oktoberfest, Karneval, Weihnachten — German traditions are essay-rich.
meta_desc: German: customs, traditions, festivals in D-A-CH.
final_note: Tradition lives in language — name it and honour it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Oktoberfest in Munich began in 1810 — over six million visitors. Es findet jedes Jahr im September statt.
Rheinland's Karneval climaxes on Rosenmontag. Die funfte Jahreszeit — the fifth season. Cologne and Mainz are centres.
Use wahrend (whereas): Wahrend Deutsche Karneval feiern, feiern Osterreicher den Fasching.

options: A soft palatal fricative (ich-laut), made at the front of the mouth.
